items.title: Charlie De Vore Interview, 1962-07-04
items.q: Well listen to Henderson before, Louie, and after they were in the band.

ctx.x: Bands like that, I don't know if you heard of them, but all the modern guys rave about that.

Yeah, I never heard of myself. I believe that the New Orleans influence on music in America never be overly stressed. And I've heard some guys saying, well, jazz started everywhere, it just didn't start in New Orleans. But everything seems to refute that. The bands that were really showed the way, the ones that were the most significant bands had New Orleans men in them. And it wasn't just an accident that they were in the band either. Well listen to Henderson before, Louie, and after they were in the band.…
